items.summary: Recommend maintaining containment-only execution. Do not admit new queue work, requeue failures, expand monetization, or authorize spend. Revenue support is limited to Amazon data for 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; the $4.92 cannot be assigned to sites. AI usage is $945.2473 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-29, but it is not period-matched to revenue and infrastructure, labor, operating, commitment, and budget data are unavailable. Therefore contribution margin, budget exposure, ROI, payback, forecast, and cost-to-learn are unknown. Continue the existing period-aligned finance reconciliation only; do not extrapolate one-day revenue or compare September AI spend to it. Minimum evidence for a finance conclusion is a dated ledger matching revenue, AI, infrastructure, labor, operating costs, commitments, and budget ceilings to the same site/content and period, plus an approved learning threshold.

The three deferred control-plane specifications may remain deferred as non-financial concepts, but none should be admitted this cycle. They do not establish revenue, contribution margin, savings, cost-to-learn, or budget benefit. Any future prototype should remain report-only and compete for capacity only after containment clears; its success must be measured with existing records, not proposal volume or activity counts.
